Author: AlexFlipnote
Name: The Holiest Fluffiness
Punchline: A tweak plugin born for the free company 'The Holiest Fluffiness', now open for all to enjoy.
Description: A tweak plugin born for the free company 'The Holiest Fluffiness', now open for all to enjoy.
Changelog: Added an "Auto-copy lottery sales" option under Settings > Indicators > Ward Info. When it is on, opening a "For Sale" placard that sells via lottery copies the sale to your clipboard right away, the same as pressing "Copy sale", so it is ready to paste without the extra click. The lottery panel and its "Copy sale" button stay as they were. Off by default, since it overwrites whatever was on your clipboard.
